name: Effective Range of Repeated-Coordinate Cubes
proof: There are n-1 singleton coordinate groups and $2^{n-1}$ copies of the first bit. Every one of these coordinates takes both labels because its underlying bit varies freely. Thus all domain coordinates are effective, giving effective range $n-1+2^{n-1}$. Equal columns still correspond to distinct domain coordinates.
references: Local definition-driven proof; bounded independent replay in sync/verify_noclashing_antichain_gap.py.
